skills.name: vaper-club-discovery
skills.description: Search Vaper.club for vape industry posts, brands and retail shops. Use when users ask about industry news, articles, brand background or where shops are located.

skills.name: vaper-club-product-research
skills.description: Research and compare vape products with Vaper.club data. Use when users want to find a product, identify its model, see prices and stock across shops, or compare offers of the same model.

skills.name: vaper-club-brand-research
skills.description: Build a brand profile from Vaper.club data. Use when users ask about a vape brand's background, official website, company, aliases, product categories or models.

skills.name: vaper-club-product-reviews
skills.description: Summarize user reviews of a vape product from Vaper.club. Use when users ask what people think of a product, its rating, or common praise and complaints.
